title: decompose:workspace
description: Open the decomposition workspace on a proposal: the screens with the proposed domains outlined, merge / split / rename / move, agent suggestions and approval — served on this machine, every change a named edit (ADR-116).

evidence.description: The decompose:capture evidence bundle to show (default: the proposal directory's parent)

who.description: Name recorded on comments and approvals (default: git's user.name)

commit.description: Commit the proposal when it is approved (ADR-116 §5)

agent.description: Connect the agent pane to a hosted model through coder:suggest when ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is set (ADR-117)

model.description: The model the agent asks (default: coder:suggest's)

build.description: Install and build the workspace MFE first (needed once, and after an upgrade)

exit-after-start.description: Start, report where, and stop — for checks and scripts

approvals.description: Each approval made while it ran, and whether it was committed.
